verdicts.reason: Both candidates are practically the same. The crowd illustration, which carries the original's imagery, shrinks to a thin, almost unreadable strip at the top. The quote is set very large and breaks into 12 short lines with awkward breaks ('NEVER / DOUBT THAT', 'INDEED,' left alone on its own line), and 'THOUGHTFUL' and 'CAN CHANGE' run right up to the right edge. The attribution is in a cramped block of 4 lines with an empty band below it. The two differ only by a few pixels of vertical offset, so neither is better.
